tools.name: get_service_profile
tools.description: Returns what Spedition Log (Logisticoo GmbH) offers: services, what is not offered, whether prices are available, how to submit an inquiry, contact and legal links. Call this first.

tools.name: estimate_transport_price
tools.description: Starting prices exactly as published by Spedition Log on https://www.spedition-log.com/preise: part load (LTL) per pallet, full load (FTL) and 40 t semi-trailer "from" prices. No route-based calculation; direct/special runs are quoted individually. Never present a starting price as the final price.

tools.description: Step 1 of 2 for a real transport inquiry to the operator's sales team (they reply by e-mail with a quote). tools.description: Step 2 of 2: sends the previewed inquiry to the operator's sales team. Only call after the user explicitly confirmed the summary and privacy notice. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "preview_inquiry" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
